strengths: Correctly prioritized microglia using canonical markers P2ry12, Cx3cr1, Siglech, Fcrls, Gpr34.
Recognized activated/DAM-like state from Trem2, C1q, Cd68 while noting P2ry12 is not top-ranked.
weaknesses: DAM call was somewhat overstated given Clec7a was not observed; transitional/activated microglia is equally plausible.

strengths: Correctly captured the broad myeloid lineage via Csf1r, Lyz2, Itgam, Adgre1, Cd68.
weaknesses: Too coarse; failed to refine to microglia despite strong microglial-specific evidence (P2ry12, Cx3cr1, Siglech, Fcrls, Gpr34).

strengths: Used canonical microglial markers (P2ry12, Cx3cr1, Siglech, Trem2) and exclusion of monocyte/DC/neutrophil markers to assign microglia.
Matches final lineage at exact ontology granularity.
weaknesses: Relied partly on absence of other myeloid markers; some enriched terms are broad immune pathways rather than microglia-specific.

supporting: Microglial-specific markers P2ry12, Cx3cr1, Siglech, Fcrls, and Gpr34 in the top DEG list directly support refinement from myeloid cell (CL:0000763) to microglial cell (CL:0000129).
Myeloid/microglial context supported by C1qa, C1qb, C1qc, Trem2, Ctss, Cd68, Csf1r, Adgre1, Itgam.
enrichment_or_literature: Microglial cell activation and neuroinflammatory response terms were enriched, consistent with an activated microglial state.
Complement cascade and DAP12 signaling terms further support microglial effector function.
